# xlt-token

> Framework-agnostic token authentication library for TypeScript, inspired by Sa-Token.

xlt-token is a pnpm monorepo that provides token login, logout, session, permissions, roles, multi-device login, secondary authentication, JWT support, pluggable storage, token strategies, hooks, and framework adapters.

## Primary Packages

- `@xlt-token/core`: framework-agnostic authentication engine, store contracts, token strategies, permissions, sessions, hooks, HTTP context, and errors.
- `@xlt-token/store-redis`: framework-agnostic RedisStore and IORedisStore for node-redis and ioredis.
- `@xlt-token/nestjs`: NestJS module, guards, decorators, JwtStrategy, deprecated Redis DI wrappers, and re-exports from core.
- `@xlt-token/express`: Express middleware adapter, route helpers, request state sync, and error handler.
- `xlt-token`: compatibility package that re-exports `@xlt-token/nestjs`.

## Important Source Entry Points

- Root compatibility export: `src/index.ts`
- Core public export: `packages/core/src/index.ts`
- Core factory: `packages/core/src/factory.ts`
- Core auth engine: `packages/core/src/auth/stp-logic.ts`
- Core permission engine: `packages/core/src/auth/stp-perm-logic.ts`
- Core static facade: `packages/core/src/auth/stp-util.ts`
- Core HTTP context: `packages/core/src/http/context.ts`
- Redis Store public export: `packages/store-redis/src/index.ts`
- NestJS public export: `packages/nestjs/src/index.ts`
- NestJS module: `packages/nestjs/src/xlt-token.module.ts`
- NestJS guard: `packages/nestjs/src/guards/xlt-token.guard.ts`
- Express public export: `packages/express/src/index.ts`
- Express middleware: `packages/express/src/middleware/xlt-middleware.ts`

## Development Rules

- Use `pnpm`.
- Do not start frontend or documentation dev servers unless explicitly requested.
- If asked how to run the docs locally, tell the user to run `pnpm docs:dev`.
- Keep framework-independent behavior in `@xlt-token/core`.
- Keep Redis client integrations in `@xlt-token/store-redis`.
- Keep NestJS DI, guards, decorators, compatibility wrappers, and JwtStrategy in `@xlt-token/nestjs`.
- Keep Express middleware, route helpers, and Express error handling in `@xlt-token/express`.
- Preserve public exports in each package `src/index.ts`.
- When changing auth semantics, update tests before or alongside implementation.
- When changing public API, update docs, README files, package README files, and examples.
- Prefer existing test fixtures and local patterns over new abstractions.

## Commands

- Install dependencies: `pnpm install`
- Build workspace: `pnpm build:workspace`
- Test workspace: `pnpm test:workspace`
- Test core: `pnpm --filter @xlt-token/core test`
- Test NestJS: `pnpm --filter @xlt-token/nestjs test`
- Test Redis Store: `pnpm --filter @xlt-token/store-redis test`
- Test NestJS e2e: `pnpm --filter @xlt-token/nestjs test:e2e`
- Test Express: `pnpm --filter @xlt-token/express test`
- Run docs locally: `pnpm docs:dev`
- Build docs: `pnpm docs:build`

## API Boundaries

- `StpLogic` is the main instance API for login state and token lifecycle.
- `StpUtil` is the static facade and must be bound by framework initialization before use.
- `StpPermLogic` handles permission and role checks through `StpInterface`.
- `XltTokenStore` implementations must preserve timeout semantics.
- `TokenStrategy` implementations create and optionally verify token values.
- `HttpContext` is the framework-neutral request abstraction.
- NestJS decorators and Express route helpers should describe route auth metadata, not duplicate core auth logic.

## Validation Expectations

- Core behavior changes should run `pnpm --filter @xlt-token/core test`.
- NestJS integration changes should run `pnpm --filter @xlt-token/nestjs test` and, when route/module behavior changes, `pnpm --filter @xlt-token/nestjs test:e2e`.
- Express adapter changes should run `pnpm --filter @xlt-token/express test` and, when middleware behavior changes, `pnpm --filter @xlt-token/express test:e2e`.
- Workspace-level packaging changes should run `pnpm build:workspace`.
